issue.title: just dev-shell sets PATH to '.venv/bin:<pid>PATH' because Just passes $$ through to sh
issue.description:
Found by the sase-1le land agent on 2026-10-16 while confirming epic note #5 (the same Just `$$` misuse in the `check` recipe's docs stage, which is being fixed as sase-1le epic work). Not caused by sase-1le: the line dates from b80cde107fe (2026-02-15).

`Justfile` recipe `dev-shell` runs:

    @VIRTUAL_ENV="$(pwd)/.venv" PATH="$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$$PATH" $SHELL

Just, unlike Make, does not treat `$$` as an escaped dollar; it passes both characters to `sh`, where `$$` expands to the shell PID. The child shell therefore starts with `PATH=<repo>/.venv/bin:<pid>PATH`, dropping the inherited PATH. Interactive rc files that rebuild PATH can mask it. Root cause and fix are certain: use `$PATH`. `just --dry-run dev-shell` shows the literal `$$PATH`.

task_type_fields.impact: just dev-shell drops the caller's PATH; system tools are missing unless shell rc files rebuild PATH.
task_type_fields.repro: just --dry-run dev-shell shows PATH=...:$$PATH; sh -c 'echo $$PATH' prints <pid>PATH

issue.creation_reason: Found while confirming the same Just double-dollar bug in the check recipe for the sase-1le landing; this older recipe is not epic work.
